Hana Lee (AE): AlderBank wants a drop-in for OrbitAI for the POC. Key asks: identical stream frames, function-calling name parity, header passthrough (x-orbit-session-id), and a simple cost comparison. Need owners.
Marcus Nguyen (Eng): I'll own the shim. Plan: proxy that accepts Orbit requests, rewrites headers/body, forwards to /v1/chat, and re-streams token deltas as `event: delta` + final `event: done`.
Zoe Carter (Solutions): Add a compat flag so we can toggle strict parity (exact frames) vs tolerant mode. Will create test cases for: token order, partial function_call fragments, stop token behavior, reconnect resume.
Anika Rao (Security): Requirements: EU residency for logs, no retention of original Authorization header, redact user PII but keep session_id. I'll need sample Orbit payloads and any forwarded logs.
Liam O'Brien (Sales Ops): Pricing ask: AlderBank charges per-call flat fee. We'll compute equivalent per-call from our $/1k-tokens using their median call size (they said ~800 tokens/call). I'll draft a delta sheet.
Marcus Nguyen (Eng): Error mapping note: orbit 429 -> return 429 with `X-RateInfo: Retry-After` header. Also ensure our stream reconnects preserve chunk ordering.
Zoe Carter (Solutions): For function-calling, rename our `tool_call` fragments to `function_call` in shim so the client needs no changes. Also include example curl snippets.
build-bot: Build queued: orbit-compat-shim -> eu-central, manual approval required.
Hana Lee (AE): Schedule: internal smoke tomorrow morning, POC starts in 48h. Please post status by 5pm PT today.
Marcus Nguyen (Eng): Starting shim work now. Target internal image by EOD.
Anika Rao (Security): I'll start questionnaire and request payloads from AlderBank.
Liam O'Brien (Sales Ops): Pricing draft incoming 3pm PT with 30-day POC terms + migration credit option.
Zoe Carter (Solutions): Will post test plan and curl examples here when ready.
Hana Lee (AE): Thanks team 44d keeping this thread as single source of truth.
